title: Skyscraper complex stalk recovery
statement: For a ringed space X, point x and stalk-module cochain complex M, the stalk of the termwise ringed-module skyscraper complex at x is nonempty-isomorphic to M.

source.place: the filtered-colimit stalk computation in the proof of lem-pc-skyscraper-complex

proof.text: Construct the canonical degreewise stalk isomorphisms from the filtered-colimit description and verify compatibility with differentials and module actions.

proof_origin.place: Definition Tag 009A (case (4)) and Lemma Tag 009C, applied degreewise; filtered-colimit computation of the stalk at x

mathlib_searches.query: skyscraper sheaf complex is acyclic if and only if its stalk complex is acyclic
mathlib_searches.results: HomologicalComplex acyclicity declarations, but no theorem for skyscraper sheaves of modules; only general C-valued skyscraper constructions.
Mathlib/Topology/Sheaves/Skyscraper.lean has C-valued skyscraper stalk declarations but no O_X-module complex theorem.

lean.statement:
theorem skyscraper_complex_stalk_recovery (X : RingedSpace.{u_complex}) (x : X)
    (M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u_complex} (X.presheaf.stalk x)) ℤ) :
    Nonempty (((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X x).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
        (((ringedModuleSkyscraperFunctor X x).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj M) ≅ M)
